notes.title: Pre-Overhaul Bugfix Patch
notes.content:
Pardon our dust!

Thank you all so much for your support of this game I made back when I was 18 years old. While I work on the Overhaul Update, here's a long overdue patch!

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed that dang Day 15 bug![/b]
[*] The game is now built in current-day GameMaker
[*] Level 0 of the [i]Gametot Color[/i] toy now comes after Level 3, and after Level 0 you are taken back to Level 1
[/list]

So - about that Overhaul Update. What's planned for that once it's finished?

[list]
[*] [b]Reprogramming the game from the ground up[/b], carrying over game content
[*] The game running at 60 FPS
[*] Overhauled gameplay elements and UI controls
[*] Redrawn game sprites
[*] Improved dialog and game text
[*] The ability to choose a Buddinpal, including more than just Amaryllis and Moppy
[*] More items and toys, including ones that were finished but never made it into the game!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33667125/bac1855f4bcd507cb2e3f8c9698f3d3623f8e52d.png[/img]

This was the first game project I finished in GameMaker and I've learned so, so much about programming since then. I look forward to eventually sharing the Overhaul Update and the definitive version of Buddinpals with you!
